The [[Blindfold]] can be obtained from [[Dextarr Dirtdigger]] in [[Cathedral of Flames]] for 50 [[Diessa Chalice]]s. It has an [[Item's Attribute]] +1 bonus.

== Notes ==
* Cannot be [[dye]]d.
* Has [[clipping]] issues with headgear and hairstyles on many models, such as the female paragon's headband
* Can be [[salvage]]d into [[Bolt of Cloth|Bolts of Cloth]].

==Trivia==
* In the film [[w:Matrix Revolutions|Matrix Revolutions]], after being blinded Neo wears the same colour blindfold.
